title: Okazaki-fragment sequencing (McGuffee, Smith & Whitehouse 2013), re-analysed on sacCer3
measurement: replication fork directionality and initiation site mapping
scale: fork directionality -1 (leftward forks) to +1 (rightward forks); OEM 0 to 1

source.exclusion_reason: SSDDCS over-expression strains, and one Ion Torrent single-end library, none of them wild type on genotype

provenance.validation: Fork directionality agrees with the authors' published .sgr tracks at r = 0.969-0.971 (OEM, 1 kb windows), lifted sacCer2 -> sacCer3; the authors' own replicates agree at r = 0.9701.

calls.definition: maxima of the derivative of fork directionality, OEM > 0.05
calls.caveat: efficiencies are raw OEM; the deconvolution correction of the original paper is not applied, so values near termination zones are under-estimates
